verdicts.reason: A: the CTA is a tiny pill floating above the headline, so the reading order is reversed. The Inkwell & Lantern logo is gone. The book cover shrinks to a thumbnail lost in a confetti strip at the bottom, the body copy is nearly headline-sized, the eyebrow sits below the body, and there is dead space between the copy and the confetti. B: keeps the book cover as the key image but crams the stack edge to edge. The CTA is jammed into the top-left corner above everything, the eyebrow sits below the body, the logo is an illegible speck at bottom-left, and the confetti is gone. Still, B keeps the design more recognisable.
